TwistedFate.combo: Once Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card has been used, approach from the side or behind with Twitch Q Ambush. Throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of the enemy’s path and build more Twitch P Deadly Venom stacks with basic attacks. Use Twitch E Contaminate last, once the stacks are built.
TwistedFate.build: Prioritize magic resistance on your first purchase to withstand Twisted Fate’s magic damage. Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, W Pick a Card, and E Stacked Deck all deal magic damage, so magic resistance is more effective than armor.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card has been used is your chance to engage. You can also circle around and approach with Twitch Q Ambush while Twisted Fate R Destiny is down.
TwistedFate.fight: Don’t force your way into Twisted Fate’s basic attack range while his gold card from W Pick a Card is ready. After he uses the card, use Twitch Q Ambush to get to his side or behind him, build Twitch P Deadly Venom with basic attacks, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate.
TwistedFate.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce poke from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, and use Twitch Q Ambush to circle through bushes or along the river and look for a kill opportunity.
TwistedFate.phase: Twitch grows stronger in the mid to late game once he has attack speed and critical strike chance.
TwistedFate.teamfight: After Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is used on your frontline, use Twitch Q Ambush to take the flank. Activate Twitch R Spray and Pray, then start basic attacking along a line where enemies are lined up. Use Twitch E Contaminate on enemies with Deadly Venom stacks. If an enemy champion affected by Deadly Venom dies, check whether Twitch Q Ambush’s cooldown resets, then reposition.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has locked in a gold card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay outside his basic attack range. Stand behind minions to reduce poke from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.

Aphelios.laning: Don't keep losing health to Calibrum marks. When Aphelios has a weak weapon, use Twitch Q Ambush to pressure from the brush or river. Let your allies know when you leave lane to roam.
Aphelios.escape: If Aphelios slows you with Gravitum, delay your engage until you can avoid the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Look for a chance to close the gap with Twitch Q Ambush while his root is down and he isn't holding Severum. Twitch has no ability to escape on his own, so before going in, check whether you and your allies would be positioned to get hit by Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil.
Aphelios.fight: Watch the next weapon shown on Aphelios E Weapon Queue System and trade during a weapon window with low burst damage. Use Twitch Q Ambush to flank, but don't reveal yourself within range of Gravitum's slow and root. Stack Deadly Venom with Twitch W Venom Cask and basic attacks, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate.
Aphelios.teamfight: Don't stand in front. Once Aphelios uses his catch tool on your frontline, use Twitch Q Ambush to position at the side or behind him. Spread out from allies to avoid getting hit together by Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil, and find a line where Twitch R Spray and Pray's basic attacks pierce the clustered enemy formation. Finish off enemies marked with Deadly Venom using Twitch E Contaminate, then reposition if a kill resets Twitch Q Ambush.
Aphelios.build: Build armor first against Aphelios's primary damage. If healing offsets Twitch P Deadly Venom's damage over time, fit Executioner's Calling in after one core item. Consider Mercurial Scimitar if Gravitum's root makes it hard to hold your position during Twitch R Spray and Pray.
Aphelios.combo: Use Twitch Q Ambush to get behind or beside Aphelios, then throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of his direction of travel. Add more Twitch P Deadly Venom stacks with basic attacks, then use Twitch E Contaminate last. Activate Twitch R Spray and Pray while camouflaged, line up a piercing angle, then begin with your first basic attack.
Aphelios.phase: As Twitch E Contaminate gains ranks, the kill threat after stacking Deadly Venom increases. Twitch is strong in the mid to late game when attack speed and critical strike chance come together, so check Aphelios's weapons and root before fighting.
Aphelios.watch: If Aphelios slows you with Gravitum, get out of range before Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites roots you. Back off to avoid the extra attack when marked by Calibrum, and spread out from allies when Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil is available.

Senna.watch: Senna W Last Embrace applies a delayed root after hitting, so dodge it behind minions and move away from allies if you’re marked. Senna Q Piercing Darkness travels in a straight line past its target, so avoid the line connecting Senna to a minion or ally. If you get hit once, retreat to avoid a second hit and stop Senna from collecting Senna P Absolution mist.
Senna.build: Build armor first to defend against Senna’s main damage. If healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness offsets Twitch P Deadly Venom’s damage over time, fit Executioner's Calling in after one core item. If Senna W Last Embrace’s root makes it hard to hold your position during Twitch R Spray and Pray, consider Mercurial Scimitar.
Senna.combo: Use Twitch Q Ambush to get beside or behind Senna. Even if Senna moves into a bush or out of vision, finish with Twitch E Contaminate if she is within range.
Senna.escape: Engage with Twitch Q Ambush when Senna W Last Embrace misses and you avoid the root. Senna has no skill to create distance on her own, so take the opportunity to approach from the side or behind and attack. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist appears, allies can approach inside it too, so retreat first and secure vision.
Senna.fight: After dodging Senna W Last Embrace, close the distance from the side or behind with Twitch Q Ambush. Senna has no way to create distance on her own, so if you approach successfully, build Twitch P Deadly Venom with basic attacks and finish with Twitch E Contaminate. Avoid trades where you stand facing Senna long enough to get hit twice.
Senna.phase: In the mid game, pressure Senna by taking advantage of kill opportunities as Twitch E Contaminate’s damage increases. Twitch’s attack speed and critical strike chance become strong in the late game, but Senna also gains range and attack damage as she collects souls, so engage from the flank.
Senna.teamfight: Use Twitch Q Ambush to get to the flank or behind, and find a line where Senna and the enemy team overlap. From there, activate Twitch R Spray and Pray and start piercing basic attacks, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate if you’ve built Deadly Venom on several enemies. Reveal yourself after the enemy engage has been used on your frontline so you don’t get caught by Senna W Last Embrace, and after a kill, reposition if Twitch Q Ambush resets.

Caitlyn.phase: In the mid game, look for kill opportunities as Twitch E Contaminate gains ranks, and in the late game make use of Twitch's strength with attack speed and critical strike chance. Caitlyn gets relatively weaker as the game goes on, so don't give her an early kill by overcommitting.
Caitlyn.build: Prioritize tenacity to reduce the root from Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap and movement speed to close the gap.
Caitlyn.combo: Use Twitch Q Ambush to avoid traps and position beside or behind Caitlyn. Finish with Twitch E Contaminate if she looks likely to get away or you have stacked enough Deadly Venom.
Caitlyn.escape: Avoid paths with Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap. Approach from an angle you set up with Twitch Q Ambush during Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker's cast animation or right after she uses it.
Caitlyn.fight: Look for an opening right after Caitlyn uses Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker to clear the wave.
Caitlyn.laning: Use Twitch Q Ambush to disappear and look for a chance to get behind Caitlyn through the brush or river. Let your allies know when you leave lane.
Caitlyn.teamfight: Don't stand in front. After the enemy uses an engage tool on your frontline, use Twitch Q Ambush to position at the side or behind them. Activate Twitch R Spray and Pray while camouflaged, then start basic attacking along a line where enemies overlap. Stack Deadly Venom on multiple enemies and finish with Twitch E Contaminate. If an enemy champion affected by Deadly Venom dies and resets Twitch Q Ambush's cooldown, reposition.
Caitlyn.watch: If you step on Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, you'll be rooted and take heavy damage from Caitlyn P Headshot, so avoid traps in brush and narrow paths when engaging. Stand behind allied minions to reduce the damage from Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker poke.

Ezreal.build: The provided information doesn't determine a first purchase item. Ezreal Q Mystic Shot deals physical damage, while Ezreal W Essence Flux and Ezreal E Arcane Shift deal magic damage, so stacking only one type of resistance won't reduce all his damage evenly. Reducing his attack speed or gaining movement speed to close the gap can also be valuable against him.
Ezreal.combo: Once Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down, use Twitch Q Ambush to position beside or behind him. Activate Twitch R Spray and Pray while camouflaged, then begin your attack with the first basic attack. Throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of Ezreal's direction of travel, add Twitch P Deadly Venom stacks with basic attacks, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate.
Ezreal.escape: The window to engage is right after you make Ezreal use Ezreal E Arcane Shift. Ezreal has no crowd control, so approach at an angle that blocks his escape route, but avoid repeated hits from Ezreal Q Mystic Shot so Ezreal E Arcane Shift doesn't come back quickly.
Ezreal.fight: Don't trade poke from long range. Use Twitch Q Ambush to find a flank and close the gap. Apply brief pressure to make Ezreal use Ezreal E Arcane Shift first, then commit to a fight while it's down. Keep minions between you and Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, since repeated hits make his escape ability come back sooner.
Ezreal.laning: Use Twitch Q Ambush to circle through the brush or river and get beside or behind him, then stack Twitch P Deadly Venom and look for a finishing opportunity with Twitch E Contaminate. Let your allies know your location when you leave lane to roam.
Ezreal.phase: As Twitch E Contaminate gains ranks, the kill threat from Twitch P Deadly Venom stacks increases. Twitch peaks in the mid to late game as attack speed and critical strike chance come together. The information provided doesn't indicate which of you has the advantage at each stage against Ezreal.
Ezreal.teamfight: Don't trade poke with Ezreal from the front. Use Twitch Q Ambush to position at the side or behind him. Activate Twitch R Spray and Pray, then basic attack along a line where enemies overlap. When Twitch P Deadly Venom has stacked on multiple enemies, finish them with Twitch E Contaminate. Reposition if an enemy champion affected by Deadly Venom dies and resets Twitch Q Ambush.
Ezreal.watch: Dodge Ezreal Q Mystic Shot from behind minions, and keep making him miss so Ezreal E Arcane Shift doesn't come back quickly. If marked by Ezreal W Essence Flux, briefly get out of range because his next basic attack or ability deals extra damage. When low on health, avoid the straight path of Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage and retreat at an angle.

Ashe.combo: Use Twitch Q Ambush to take position beside or behind Ashe. Throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of where she’s moving, then stack more Twitch P Deadly Venom with basic attacks. Use Twitch E Contaminate last, after the stacks build up.
Ashe.escape: Engage when Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger’s Focus has worn off. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, don’t start a small fight from out of vision; approach with Twitch Q Ambush after you dodge the stun or Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is down. Ashe has no skill to create distance on her own, so keep pressuring her once you close the gap.
Ashe.fight: Trade after Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger’s Focus has worn off. Use Twitch Q Ambush to approach from the side or behind, reducing the time you spend walking in while taking basic attacks and being slowed by Ashe P Frost Shot. Stack Twitch P Deadly Venom with basic attacks, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate.
Ashe.laning: When Ashe W Volley is down, use Twitch Q Ambush to circle through the brush or along the river and look for a chance to get behind her. Even if you can’t get a kill, Ashe may back off when Twitch disappears, so let your allies know when you leave lane.
Ashe.teamfight: Use Twitch Q Ambush to avoid the front and take position on the flank or behind the enemy, then attack after their engage tools, including Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, have been used on your frontline. Line up the clustered enemies, activate Twitch R Spray and Pray, and start basic attacking. Stack Twitch P Deadly Venom on multiple enemies, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate. If an enemy champion dies and resets Twitch Q Ambush, reposition.
Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley provides area poke and slows in lane, so dodge to the side of its cone. Ashe P Frost Shot refreshes its slow with every basic attack, so don’t stay within her attack range for long. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is a linear attack that stuns, so change direction instead of running in a straight line.
Ashe.phase: As Twitch E Contaminate gains ranks, you can look for kills after stacking Twitch P Deadly Venom. Twitch gets stronger in the mid to late game as attack speed and critical strike chance come together, so look for fights from the flank.

Draven.build: Build armor first against Draven's primary physical damage. Keep enough health to survive the execute range of Draven R Whirling Death, and consider reducing his attack speed if you need to lower his basic attack damage.
Draven.combo: Use Twitch Q Ambush to position beside or behind Draven, then throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of where his axe will land. Stack Deadly Venom on the slowed Draven with basic attacks, then use Twitch E Contaminate last. Activate Twitch R Spray and Pray while camouflaged, line up your range and a piercing angle, then begin with your first basic attack.
Draven.escape: Approach with Twitch Q Ambush when Draven E Stand Aside is down and he has only one Draven Q Spinning Axe or has just dropped one. Account for the movement speed from Draven W Blood Rush by throwing Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of his current position, in his direction of travel.
Draven.fight: Fight when Draven has only one Draven Q Spinning Axe or has just dropped one. If you throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of where the axe will land, Draven must either take the slow to catch it or give it up. Add more Deadly Venom stacks with basic attacks, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate.
Draven.laning: If you don't give Draven a kill, you can draw him forward and make room for your jungler to come in. Let your allies know your location when you leave lane with Twitch Q Ambush.
Draven.phase: As Twitch E Contaminate gains ranks, you'll have kill opportunities using Deadly Venom stacks. Twitch gets strong in the late game with attack speed and critical strike chance, so don't die by overcommitting early.
Draven.teamfight: Use Twitch Q Ambush to flank or get behind the enemy, and attack from a line where Twitch R Spray and Pray can pierce their formation. Apply Deadly Venom to multiple enemies, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate. When an enemy champion affected by Deadly Venom dies, check whether Twitch Q Ambush's cooldown resets, then reposition.
Draven.watch: Avoid early trades while Draven is holding two Draven Q Spinning Axes. Watch for the slow and forced movement from Draven E Stand Aside, and if you dodge Draven R Whirling Death, also get out of the return path.

Jhin.build: Build armor first against Jhin's primary damage. Armor won't block the magic damage from Jhin E Captive Audience, so move away from the blast when you trigger a trap.
Jhin.combo: Use Twitch Q Ambush to position beside or behind Jhin, then throw Twitch W Venom Cask in his direction of travel. Add Twitch P Deadly Venom stacks with basic attacks, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate. Activate Twitch R Spray and Pray while camouflaged and begin basic attacking from a position with a range advantage.
Jhin.escape: Jhin has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage with Twitch Q Ambush after Jhin W Deadly Flourish misses. Right after his basic attack or trap creates the condition for a root, first get out of the line of Jhin W Deadly Flourish.
Jhin.fight: Count Jhin's shots, then approach from the side with Twitch Q Ambush while he's reloading or just after he's fired one or two shots. Avoid trading while Jhin P Whisper's final shot is ready. Once Jhin W Deadly Flourish misses, close the gap and stack Deadly Venom.
Jhin.laning: Stand one step away from low-health minions to avoid Jhin Q Dancing Grenade growing stronger as it kills targets. Use Twitch Q Ambush to circle through the brush or river and look for Jhin from behind.
Jhin.phase: As Twitch E Contaminate gains ranks, the kill threat from Twitch P Deadly Venom stacks increases. Twitch gets stronger in the mid to late game with attack speed and critical strike chance, so target Jhin from the flank.
Jhin.teamfight: Once the enemy has used their engage tool on your frontline, use Twitch Q Ambush to position at the side or behind them. Find a line where enemies overlap, then use Twitch R Spray and Pray for piercing basic attacks. When Deadly Venom has stacked on multiple enemies, finish them with Twitch E Contaminate. Watch for the root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish, and reposition if killing an enemy champion affected by Deadly Venom resets Twitch Q Ambush.
Jhin.watch: Back off while Jhin P Whisper's final shot is ready, since it deals heavy damage. Immediately after being hit by a Jhin basic attack or stepping on a Jhin E Captive Audience trap, watch for the root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish and get out of its line. When low on health, dodge Jhin R Curtain Call, which deals more damage based on missing health.

Jinx.build: Build armor first against Jinx's primary damage. Consider Mercurial Scimitar if the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers! keeps you from finding a position to attack.
Jinx.combo: Use Twitch Q Ambush to approach Jinx from the side or behind. Throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of her direction of travel to catch her, then stack Twitch P Deadly Venom and add more stacks with basic attacks. Use Twitch E Contaminate last, after the stacks have built up.
Jinx.escape: Jinx has no ability to create distance on her own, so engage after Jinx E Flame Chompers! misses or has been used. The moment Jinx W Zap! misses is also a chance to close the gap with Twitch Q Ambush. Don't start a fight right after an ally dies or a turret is destroyed, since Jinx P Get Excited! activates then.
Jinx.fight: While Jinx pokes with rockets from Jinx Q Switcheroo!, she has no minigun attack speed stacks, so look for a chance to get close and deal heavy damage in a short trade. Use Twitch Q Ambush to get beside or behind her after Jinx E Flame Chompers! misses or has been used. Stack Twitch P Deadly Venom with basic attacks, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate.
Jinx.laning: When Jinx attacks minions with rockets, position so you don't overlap with them. Use Twitch Q Ambush to circle through the brush or river and look for Jinx from behind, but let your allies know when you leave lane.
Jinx.phase: As Twitch E Contaminate gains ranks, you can look for kills after stacking Twitch P Deadly Venom. Twitch gets stronger in the mid to late game as attack speed and critical strike chance come together, so look for Jinx from the flank after completing three core items.
Jinx.teamfight: Don't stand in front. After the enemy uses an engage tool on your frontline, use Twitch Q Ambush to position at the side. When Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down, activate Twitch R Spray and Pray, then start basic attacking along a line where enemies overlap. If an enemy champion affected by Twitch P Deadly Venom dies, check whether Twitch Q Ambush resets, then reposition.
Jinx.watch: If you are rooted by Jinx E Flame Chompers!, it's hard to position even if Twitch R Spray and Pray extends your range. Jinx Q Switcheroo!'s rockets also damage nearby units, so don't stand beside minions when she farms with rockets. Don't stay within range of Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket! with health already reduced.

Kaisa.build: Build armor first against Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain and her basic attacks. If the magic damage from Kai'Sa P Second Skin and Kai'Sa W Void Seeker is also troublesome and she is hard to kill in one go, build magic resistance and health together afterward.
Kaisa.combo: Use Twitch Q Ambush to position beside or behind Kai'Sa. Throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of her direction of travel and add Deadly Venom stacks with basic attacks, then use Twitch E Contaminate last. Activate Twitch R Spray and Pray while using Ambush, then begin basic attacking with its increased range.
Kaisa.escape: If you've been hit by Kai'Sa W Void Seeker or have Kai'Sa P Second Skin stacks built up, don't go in; back off.
Kaisa.fight: Use Twitch Q Ambush to flank, but start fights while Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is down. Stack enough Deadly Venom with Twitch W Venom Cask and basic attacks, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate. If health has dropped while Kai'Sa P Second Skin stacks are built up, stop fighting and back off.
Kaisa.laning: If Kai'Sa looks ready to use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, stand beside allied minions to spread out the missiles. Once Twitch E Contaminate deals more damage, stack Deadly Venom and look for a kill.
Kaisa.phase: As Twitch E Contaminate gains ranks, the kill threat from Deadly Venom stacks increases. In the mid to late game, when attack speed and critical strike chance come together, use Twitch's strengths to fight from the flank.
Kaisa.teamfight: Use Twitch Q Ambush to position at the side, then reveal yourself after Kai'Sa uses her engage on your frontline. Activate Twitch R Spray and Pray, then basic attack from an angle where enemies overlap. When Deadly Venom has stacked on multiple enemies, use Twitch E Contaminate. When an enemy champion affected by Deadly Venom dies and Twitch Q Ambush's cooldown resets, reposition.
Kaisa.watch: After being hit by Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, watch for the dash from Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct. If hit, retreat toward your allies until the mark disappears. Kai'Sa P Second Skin hurts more when your health is low, so if stacks build up, stay out of range until they wear off.

Kalista.build: Build armor first to prepare for the physical damage from Kalista Q Pierce and Kalista E Rend. Kalista W Sentinel deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about choices that add a lot of health alone.
Kalista.combo: Use Twitch Q Ambush to get beside or behind Kalista. Throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of where she is moving, then add more Twitch P Deadly Venom stacks with basic attacks. Finish with Twitch E Contaminate when Kalista disappears from vision or tries to leave basic attack range.
Kalista.escape: While Kalista R Fate's Call is down, look for an opening with less concern about the support engaging. Kalista P Martial Poise’s leap requires a basic attack animation, so throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of her movement when that animation starts. If several spears are lodged in you, don’t engage; create distance first.
Kalista.fight: Don’t commit to a long fight using only Twitch’s weak early basic attacks. Use Twitch Q Ambush to flank, then throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of Kalista’s path to apply Deadly Venom. Add more stacks with basic attacks, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate.
Kalista.laning: Use bushes or walls to break Kalista’s vision, which can cause basic attacks already in flight to miss. Use Twitch Q Ambush to circle around through bushes or the river and look for a kill, and alert your allies when leaving lane.
Kalista.phase: As Twitch E Contaminate gains levels, build Deadly Venom stacks and look for a kill. In the mid to late game, use Twitch’s strength from stacking attack speed and critical strike chance to fight from the flank.
Kalista.teamfight: When Kalista stays with her support, spread out to prepare for Kalista R Fate's Call. After the enemy engage is used on your frontline, use Twitch Q Ambush to flank and activate Twitch R Spray and Pray, then basic attack along a line where enemies overlap. Use Twitch E Contaminate on enemies with Deadly Venom, and after killing an enemy champion, check whether Twitch Q Ambush is available again so you can reposition.
Kalista.watch: Kalista E Rend deals damage based on the spears lodged in you and applies a slow. If several spears are lodged in you and health drops, stop fighting and leave lane until they disappear. When Kalista stays close to her support, watch for Kalista R Fate's Call and move away from the expected landing point.

KogMaw.build: Twitch becomes strong in the mid to late game once he has attack speed and critical strike chance, so build toward increasing that damage. If you need defensive stats, prioritize magic resistance against Kog'Maw’s magic damage, and also consider armor against his basic attacks. Avoid relying on health alone because of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage.
KogMaw.combo: Use Twitch Q Ambush to get beside or behind Kog'Maw, then throw Twitch W Venom Cask in the direction he is moving. Add more Twitch P Deadly Venom stacks with basic attacks, then use Twitch E Contaminate last. When using Twitch R Spray and Pray, activate it while camouflaged, line up the piercing shot, then start basic attacking.
KogMaw.escape: Kog'Maw has no skill that lets him create distance on his own, so engage after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends and you’ve dodged the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze. If Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle reduced your resistances, wait for that effect to pass before approaching with Twitch Q Ambush.
KogMaw.fight: Fight from the flank or behind with Twitch Q Ambush after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends. If hit by Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, don’t get close while your resistances are reduced. Avoid the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze, then close the distance. Build Deadly Venom with basic attacks and Twitch W Venom Cask, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate.
KogMaw.laning: Avoid trading while Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active. When it ends, pressure him by circling through a bush or the river with Twitch Q Ambush. Disrupt Kog'Maw’s farming and extend your lead through early and mid-game objectives and towers.
KogMaw.phase: Look for kills once Twitch E Contaminate starts dealing more damage, and accelerate the game early to mid by disrupting Kog'Maw’s farming. Kog'Maw gets stronger over time, and Twitch is also strong in the mid to late game once he has attack speed and critical strike chance.
KogMaw.teamfight: Don’t stand in front; use Twitch Q Ambush to get to the flank or behind. Activate Twitch R Spray and Pray, then basic attack along a line where enemies overlap. If you’ve applied Deadly Venom to several enemies, finish with Twitch E Contaminate. After killing Kog'Maw, retreat to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise, then check for a reset on Twitch Q Ambush and reposition.
KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, Kog'Maw's attack range increases and his basic attacks deal damage based on your maximum health, so keep your distance until it ends. Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle lowers armor and magic resistance, so block it behind minions or dodge to the side. When low on health, move out of vision to avoid Kog'Maw R Living Artillery. After killing Kog'Maw, move away from his corpse to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.

Lucian.build: Buy armor first to prepare for the physical damage from Lucian Q Piercing Light and Lucian R The Culling. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Lucian W Ardent Blaze, and no specific Twitch purchase is listed in the source material.
Lucian.combo: When Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is down, use Twitch Q Ambush to get beside or behind him. Throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of where he is moving, then add more Deadly Venom stacks with basic attacks. Even if Lucian runs out of basic attack range, use Twitch E Contaminate last if he is still within its range.
Lucian.escape: Right after Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is the window to close the distance with Twitch Q Ambush. If an ally is immobilized or Lucian receives a shield or heal, dodge his next two empowered shots and delay your engage.
Lucian.fight: Avoid Lucian’s first combo and extend the fight after his abilities are down. In particular, immediately after Lucian uses E Relentless Pursuit, approach from the side or behind with Twitch Q Ambush and build Deadly Venom with basic attacks and Twitch W Venom Cask. If you let Lucian land repeated basic attacks for too long, Lucian E Relentless Pursuit comes back sooner, so don’t miss your window to retaliate.
Lucian.laning: Avoid Lucian Q Piercing Light’s piercing angle, and look for a chance to finish with Twitch E Contaminate after building Deadly Venom. Use Twitch Q Ambush to pressure by circling through bushes or the river, and alert your allies when leaving lane.
Lucian.phase: In the mid game, use the increased stack damage from Twitch E Contaminate to look for kills. Twitch gets stronger in the late game as his attack speed and critical strike chance come together, so create opportunities to deal sustained damage from a safe position.
Lucian.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. After an enemy engage ability, such as Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, is used on your frontline, use Twitch Q Ambush to get to the flank. While camouflaged, activate Twitch R Spray and Pray and start basic attacking from an angle where enemies overlap in a line. Once several enemies have Deadly Venom, finish with Twitch E Contaminate. When an enemy champion affected by Deadly Venom dies, check whether Twitch Q Ambush’s cooldown resets, then reposition.
Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light passes through minions and reaches farther than its indicated range, so move out of the line behind the minion Lucian is farming. After Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, watch for the short burst of damage from Lucian P Lightslinger. When Lucian R The Culling starts, dodge to the side instead of running straight back.

MissFortune.build: Build armor first to reduce damage from Miss Fortune P Love Tap, Q Double Up, and R Bullet Time. Armor can’t reduce the magic damage from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain.
MissFortune.combo: Use Twitch Q Ambush to get behind or beside Miss Fortune, then throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of where she is moving. Add more Deadly Venom stacks with basic attacks, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate. When using Twitch R Spray and Pray, activate it while camouflaged and start your first basic attack with its increased range.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no skill that lets her create distance, so dodge the area from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then approach with Twitch Q Ambush. If Miss Fortune R Bullet Time has already started, move to the side of its fixed cone before looking for an opening to engage.
MissFortune.fight: Early on, look for an opening to build Deadly Venom and finish with Twitch E Contaminate instead of taking reckless basic attack trades. Move away from the area covered by Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then approach from the flank with Twitch Q Ambush once you’re outside it. Damaging a fleeing Miss Fortune resets the movement speed from Miss Fortune W Strut, so use Twitch W Venom Cask when chasing.
MissFortune.laning: Stand beside a minion rather than directly behind it to avoid Miss Fortune Q Double Up, and create distance right after she last-hits a minion. When a kill opportunity appears, use Twitch Q Ambush to circle through a bush or the river and get behind or beside Miss Fortune.
MissFortune.phase: In the mid game, as Twitch E Contaminate gains levels, look for kills by building Deadly Venom stacks. In the late game, use Twitch’s strength from stacking attack speed and critical strike chance to attack from the flank in team fights.
MissFortune.teamfight: Delay your engage while standing on the area from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, and dodge the cone from Miss Fortune R Bullet Time to the side. Use Twitch Q Ambush to get to the flank, activate Twitch R Spray and Pray, then basic attack in the direction where enemies overlap in a line. When an enemy champion affected by Deadly Venom dies, check for a reset on Twitch Q Ambush and reposition.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces toward targets behind minions, so don’t stand in a line with a minion. Don’t start a fight on the slow field from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, move to the side of its fixed cone.

Nilah.build: Complete one core item first. If healing from Nilah P Joy Unending and Nilah Q Formless Blade and R Apotheosis offsets Twitch P Deadly Venom’s damage, fit Executioner's Calling into your build. If you need defense, prioritize armor to match Nilah’s main damage type, and also build health to account for the penetration on Nilah Q Formless Blade.
Nilah.combo: Use Twitch Q Ambush to get beside or behind Nilah, then start basic attacking after Nilah W Jubilant Veil ends. Throw Twitch W Venom Cask in the direction Nilah is moving and add more Twitch P Deadly Venom stacks with basic attacks. Use Twitch E Contaminate last when Nilah moves away or when you can finish her.
Nilah.escape: There’s an opening right after Nilah E Slipstream is down, but its cooldown is short, so don’t stay for long. Confirm that Nilah W Jubilant Veil has also been used, then flank with Twitch Q Ambush. If Nilah R Apotheosis is still available, watch out for its pull range.
Nilah.fight: Don’t force basic attacks before Nilah W Jubilant Veil is down. Build Twitch P Deadly Venom stacks from a range where Nilah can’t reach you, using Twitch W Venom Cask and basic attacks, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate while Nilah is within its range.
Nilah.laning: Nilah is a melee marksman, so harass from outside her range and watch for angles where she can close in with Nilah E Slipstream. Use Twitch Q Ambush to circle through a bush or the river and look for Nilah from behind, and alert your allies when leaving lane.
Nilah.phase: In the mid game, as Twitch E Contaminate gains levels, kills become more likely after building Twitch P Deadly Venom stacks. Twitch is strong in the late game once he has attack speed and critical strike chance, so look to engage from the flank instead of fighting head-on.
Nilah.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to avoid several of you being pulled together by Nilah R Apotheosis. After Nilah E Slipstream and W Jubilant Veil have been spent, use Twitch Q Ambush to get to the flank and start basic attacking with Twitch R Spray and Pray from an angle where enemies overlap in a line. If you kill an enemy affected by Twitch P Deadly Venom and Twitch Q Ambush’s cooldown resets, reposition.
Nilah.watch: When Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, Twitch’s basic attacks miss, so stop trading basic attacks until it ends. Right after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, Nilah's attack range increases, so take another step back. Keep your distance and avoid angles where Nilah can engage with Nilah E Slipstream or pull you in with Nilah R Apotheosis.

Samira.build: Build armor first to prepare for Samira’s main damage. Also account for the fact that armor won’t block the magic damage from Samira P Daredevil Impulse and E Wild Rush.
Samira.combo: Use Twitch Q Ambush to get beside or behind Samira, then throw W Venom Cask ahead of where she is moving after Samira W Blade Whirl ends. Add more Twitch P Deadly Venom stacks with basic attacks, then finish with E Contaminate. When using Twitch R Spray and Pray, activate it while camouflaged, line up the piercing angle, then start basic attacking.
Samira.escape: If Samira E Wild Rush is down and hasn’t reset from a kill, that’s your window to go in. After the enemy support’s crowd control has been used on your frontline, approach from the flank with Twitch Q Ambush. Wait for Samira W Blade Whirl to end before starting your basic attacks.
Samira.fight: Keep your distance as Samira walks in and build Deadly Venom. Use basic attacks after Samira W Blade Whirl ends. If Samira E Wild Rush is down and no one has died, that’s an opportunity to fight from the flank with Twitch Q Ambush. Use Twitch E Contaminate to finish after building enough Deadly Venom stacks.
Samira.laning: Keep your distance, build Twitch P Deadly Venom, and manage the angles from which Samira can come forward. When a kill opportunity appears, use Twitch Q Ambush to circle through a bush or the river and get to the flank.
Samira.phase: In the mid game, as Twitch E Contaminate gains levels, look for kills using Deadly Venom stacks. Twitch gets stronger in the late game once he has attack speed and critical strike chance, so find a flank angle for Twitch R Spray and Pray to pierce through enemies.
Samira.teamfight: After the enemy engage and crowd control are used on your frontline, use Twitch Q Ambush to get to the flank or behind. Once Samira W Blade Whirl ends, activate Twitch R Spray and Pray and basic attack along a line where enemies overlap. If Samira engages with E Wild Rush and no one dies, focus her then. If you kill an enemy affected by Deadly Venom and Twitch Q Ambush resets, reposition.
Samira.watch: While Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning, it destroys projectiles, so use Twitch’s basic attacks and Twitch R Spray and Pray basic attacks after the spin ends.

Seraphine.build: Complete your first core item first. If healing from Seraphine W Surround Sound offsets Twitch P Deadly Venom’s damage over time, fit Executioner's Calling into your build next. Build magic resistance to defend against Seraphine’s damage.
Seraphine.combo: Use Twitch Q Ambush to get beside or behind Seraphine, then throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of where she is moving. Add more Twitch P Deadly Venom stacks with basic attacks, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate. When using Twitch R Spray and Pray, activate it while camouflaged and start your first basic attack from a piercing angle.
Seraphine.escape: The opening to engage Seraphine comes right after you dodge Seraphine E Beat Drop. Seraphine has no mobility skill, so if you close the distance with Twitch Q Ambush then, it’s hard for her to escape. If you’re slowed, prioritize getting out of the straight line in front of Seraphine over engaging.
Seraphine.fight: Trade after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop or when Seraphine is separated from the ranged carry. Approach from the side or behind with Twitch Q Ambush and throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of where Seraphine is moving to build Deadly Venom. Use Twitch E Contaminate to finish after adding more stacks with basic attacks.
Seraphine.laning: Use Twitch Q Ambush from a bush or the river to look for Seraphine from behind, and pressure her when she is alone or Seraphine E Beat Drop is down. Alert your allies when leaving lane to move around.
Seraphine.phase: As Twitch E Contaminate gains levels, build Deadly Venom stacks and then look for a kill. In the mid to late game, once you have attack speed and critical strike chance, find a place to fight from the flank.
Seraphine.teamfight: Spread out to either side of your allies so Seraphine R Encore can’t extend its range by hitting them in a line. After the enemy’s engage ability is used on your frontline, use Twitch Q Ambush to get to the flank and pierce the grouped formation with Twitch R Spray and Pray. Once several enemies have Deadly Venom, finish with Twitch E Contaminate. If an enemy champion affected by Deadly Venom dies and Twitch Q Ambush resets, reposition.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If slowed, leave the straight line in front of Seraphine. Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits an allied champion, so don’t stand in a line with your allies.

Sivir.build: Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet. If the healing from Sivir E Spell Shield offsets Twitch P Deadly Venom’s damage over time, slot in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Sivir.combo: Use Twitch Q Ambush to get to the side or behind Sivir, then bait out Sivir E Spell Shield first. Next, throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of Sivir’s path and use basic attacks to build more Twitch P Deadly Venom stacks. Use Twitch E Contaminate last, before Sivir can get away.
Sivir.escape: Engage after Sivir E Spell Shield is down. Sivir has no ability to create distance on her own, so close the gap with Twitch Q Ambush and look for a chance to catch her. If Sivir R On The Hunt is active, avoid a long chase until it ends.
Sivir.fight: Don’t try to finish trades with Twitch’s basic attacks alone. Stack Twitch P Deadly Venom and look to finish with Twitch E Contaminate. Bait out Sivir E Spell Shield first, then approach from the side or behind with Twitch Q Ambush. While Sivir R On The Hunt is active, take only short fights around terrain and vision instead of chasing for long.
Sivir.laning: Use Twitch Q Ambush to circle through bushes or along the river and get behind Sivir. Since Sivir clears waves quickly, push first or make sure an ally is ready to catch the wave before leaving lane. Tell your allies your location when you leave lane.
Sivir.phase: In the mid game, Twitch E Contaminate gains levels and creates stronger kill opportunities, so look for openings when Sivir E Spell Shield is down. In the late game, Twitch becomes stronger when attack speed and critical strike chance come together, so start fights from the flank.
Sivir.teamfight: Use Twitch Q Ambush to get to the flank or rear, then line up Twitch R Spray and Pray so your piercing basic attacks hit enemies standing in a row. If Sivir E Spell Shield is down, you can focus Sivir, but avoid long chases while Sivir R On The Hunt is active. If an enemy champion affected by Twitch P Deadly Venom dies and resets Twitch Q Ambush’s cooldown, reposition.
Sivir.watch: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade can hit on both the outward and return paths, so dodge the first hit and move out of the way of its return path too. Sivir E Spell Shield blocks one ability, so don’t try to finish her with Twitch E Contaminate while the shield is still up. When Sivir R On The Hunt is active, her whole team moves faster, so avoid long chases.

Smolder.build: Complete one of Twitch’s core items first. If the healing from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! offsets Twitch P Deadly Venom’s damage over time, slot in Executioner's Calling. If you need resistances, build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!. However, resistances cannot block the true damage from a grown Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath.
Smolder.combo: Approach Smolder from the side or behind with Twitch Q Ambush, then throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of his path. Build more Twitch P Deadly Venom stacks with basic attacks and use Twitch E Contaminate last. When using Twitch R Spray and Pray, activate it after taking position with Twitch Q Ambush, then start basic attacking.
Smolder.escape: Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is his only escape, so it’s a good idea to approach with Twitch Q Ambush right after he uses it. Dodge the slow from Smolder W Achooo! before engaging, and if Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! leaves flames on the ground, move out first, then re-engage.
Smolder.fight: Right after Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, use Twitch Q Ambush to take the flank and close the gap. Catch him with Twitch W Venom Cask, stack Twitch P Deadly Venom with basic attacks, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate. Dodge Smolder W Achooo! first so you don’t fight while slowed.
Smolder.laning: Use Twitch Q Ambush to circle through bushes or along the river and pressure Smolder’s farming, making it harder for him to kill minions with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and gain growth stacks. Tell your allies when you leave lane to move elsewhere.
Smolder.phase: Smolder has few stacks of Smolder P Dragon Practice early on, giving you a chance to pressure his farming. Twitch grows stronger as Twitch E Contaminate gains levels and kill pressure increases, and in the mid to late game when attack speed and critical strike chance come together. However, Smolder’s growth stacks are permanent, so play to secure objectives and turrets in the mid game and end the game.
Smolder.teamfight: Use Twitch Q Ambush to get to the flank or rear, then reveal yourself after Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap or the enemy team’s engage abilities are down. Use Twitch R Spray and Pray to basic attack through a line of overlapping enemies, build Deadly Venom stacks, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate. If an enemy champion affected by Deadly Venom dies and resets Twitch Q Ambush’s cooldown, reposition.
Smolder.watch: If Smolder W Achooo! hits a champion, it slows them and grants him growth stacks, so dodge it by standing behind minions or moving to the side. Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! deals heavy damage at its center and heals Smolder, so move out of the flames, then re-engage. Be especially careful at low health around a grown Smolder’s Q Super Scorcher Breath, which deals damage based on your maximum health and can execute you.

Tristana.combo: After Tristana W Rocket Jump is down, approach from the flank or behind with Twitch Q Ambush. Throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of Tristana’s path and use basic attacks to build more Deadly Venom stacks. Use Twitch E Contaminate to finish once the stacks are built.
Tristana.escape: Engage right after you make Tristana use W Rocket Jump. If both Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are available, don’t force an engage without a way to keep her in place.
Tristana.fight: The moment after Tristana W Rocket Jump is down is your chance to close the gap. Use Twitch Q Ambush to get to her side or behind her, then stack Deadly Venom with Twitch W Venom Cask and basic attacks before finishing with Twitch E Contaminate. If Tristana R Buster Shot is still available, engage carefully since she can knock you back.
Tristana.laning: Keep your distance from allied minions to avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge. Push the wave, taking advantage of how difficult it is for Tristana to last-hit in front of a turret, then target her with Twitch Q Ambush when she comes out to pressure the turret.
Tristana.phase: As Twitch E Contaminate gains levels, look for kill opportunities by using Deadly Venom stacks. Twitch’s damage is strong in the mid to late game when attack speed and critical strike chance come together. Tristana is difficult to handle with a completed build, so aim to end the game before then.
Tristana.teamfight: After Tristana uses her engage ability on your frontline, use Twitch Q Ambush to get to the flank or rear. Activate Twitch R Spray and Pray, then start basic attacking along a line where enemies are lined up. If several enemies have Deadly Venom, use Twitch E Contaminate to finish them. If an enemy champion affected by Deadly Venom dies and resets Twitch Q Ambush, reposition; if your allies fall first and your team is pushed back, retreat immediately.
Tristana.watch: Don’t stand near allied minions to avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge. Tristana W Rocket Jump can create or close distance, and Tristana R Buster Shot stuns and knocks you back, so don’t engage carelessly while both abilities are available.

Varus.build: Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows. Consider Mercurial Scimitar if you’re bound by Varus R Chain of Corruption, since it makes it hard to take advantage of the range advantage from Twitch R Spray and Pray.
Varus.combo: Use Twitch Q Ambush to get to Varus’s side or behind him, then throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of his path. Follow with basic attacks to build more Deadly Venom stacks, then use Twitch E Contaminate last.
Varus.escape: Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, so look for a chance to close the gap with Twitch Q Ambush after Varus R Chain of Corruption is down. You can also approach while dodging sideways out of the path of Varus Q Piercing Arrow as he aims it.
Varus.fight: When you see Varus Q Piercing Arrow being aimed, dodge sideways out of its path while looking for a chance to approach with Twitch Q Ambush. If Varus has built Blight stacks with basic attacks, don’t keep trading within his ability range; fight again after the stacks expire.
Varus.laning: Use Twitch Q Ambush to circle through bushes or along the river and get behind or to the side of Varus, then look for a chance to build Deadly Venom stacks and finish with Twitch E Contaminate.
Varus.phase: As Twitch E Contaminate gains levels, it creates kill opportunities with Deadly Venom stacks, and Twitch grows stronger in the mid to late game when attack speed and critical strike chance come together. If Varus gets a takedown or assist during a teamfight, wait out the few seconds of his empowered state before re-engaging.
Varus.teamfight: Use Twitch Q Ambush to take the flank, activate Twitch R Spray and Pray, then start basic attacking from an angle where enemies are lined up. If Varus R Chain of Corruption hits an ally, move away so it doesn’t spread to you. If you kill an enemy with Deadly Venom and Twitch Q Ambush resets, reposition.
Varus.watch: If Varus W Blighted Quiver is applied when you’re hit by an ability, it triggers damage based on your maximum health. If Varus has hit you with several basic attacks, back away to give the Blight stacks time to expire. Don’t move close to an ally hit by Varus R Chain of Corruption.

Vayne.build: If you need a defensive item, build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn. Vayne W Silver Bolts’ true damage cannot be reduced with armor and scales with maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health to survive. Vayne’s damage centers on her basic attacks and attack speed, so consider effects that reduce attack speed too.
Vayne.combo: Approach Vayne from the side or behind with Twitch Q Ambush, then throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of her path. Follow with basic attacks to build Twitch P Deadly Venom stacks, then use Twitch E Contaminate last. When using Twitch R Spray and Pray, activate it after taking position with Twitch Q Ambush, then start your first basic attack from the increased range.
Vayne.escape: Take the chance to approach with Twitch Q Ambush right after Vayne uses Q Tumble. If Vayne E Condemn is still available, don’t move into a position with a wall behind you. After she uses E Condemn, catch her with Twitch W Venom Cask and follow up with basic attacks.
Vayne.fight: The moment after you make Vayne use Q Tumble is your chance to close the gap. Use Twitch Q Ambush to get to her side or behind her, but don’t start attacking where Vayne E Condemn can knock you into a wall. Build Twitch P Deadly Venom with basic attacks and Twitch W Venom Cask, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate.
Vayne.laning: Vayne is also weak in health and armor early, so pressure her from a safe position and disrupt her farming. Use Twitch Q Ambush to circle through bushes or along the river and target her from behind, but don’t put a wall behind you; wait for a chance to finish with Twitch E Contaminate.
Vayne.phase: Twitch gains kill opportunities as Twitch E Contaminate levels up and is strong in the mid to late game once he has attack speed and critical strike chance. Vayne becomes harder to deal with as the game goes on, so secure your lead with objectives and turrets in the early and mid game.
Vayne.teamfight: Use Twitch Q Ambush to get to the flank or backline, and start attacking after Vayne uses her engage ability on your frontline. Activate Twitch R Spray and Pray and basic attack along a line where enemies are lined up, then use Twitch E Contaminate once Twitch P Deadly Venom has stacked on several enemies. If an enemy champion affected by Deadly Venom dies and resets Twitch Q Ambush’s cooldown, reposition.
Vayne.watch: Don’t fight with a wall behind you, since Vayne E Condemn can knock you into it and stun you. Vayne W Silver Bolts deals true damage based on your maximum health after a certain number of attacks hit the same target, so count the hits and move out of range just before it triggers. During Vayne R Final Hour, Vayne Q Tumble briefly makes her invisible each time, so check her position again before attacking.

Xayah.build: Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Xayah P Clean Cuts, Xayah Q Double Daggers, and Xayah W Deadly Plumage. Consider Mercurial Scimitar if Xayah E Bladecaller’s root makes it difficult to hold your position during Twitch R Spray and Pray.
Xayah.combo: Use Twitch Q Ambush to get to Xayah’s side or behind her, and start attacking after confirming Xayah R Featherstorm is down. Throw Twitch W Venom Cask in Xayah’s path and build more Deadly Venom stacks with basic attacks, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate. When using Twitch R Spray and Pray, activate it while camouflaged, line up your piercing attacks, then start your first basic attack.
Xayah.escape: Move sideways out of the feather return paths to avoid the root from Xayah E Bladecaller, then approach with Twitch Q Ambush.
Xayah.fight: Xayah’s feathers build up if you fight in the same spot for too long, so keep trades short and shift to the side. When Xayah R Featherstorm is down, approach from the flank with Twitch Q Ambush, stack Deadly Venom, and finish with Twitch E Contaminate.
Xayah.laning: Use Twitch Q Ambush to circle through bushes or along the river and get behind Xayah, while continuing to move sideways so you don’t stand in the return path of Xayah E Bladecaller. Tell your allies when you leave lane to move elsewhere.
Xayah.phase: In the mid game, Twitch E Contaminate gains levels and creates stronger kill opportunities by building Deadly Venom stacks. Twitch is strong in the late game once he has attack speed and critical strike chance, so check Xayah R Featherstorm and Xayah E Bladecaller before fighting.
Xayah.teamfight: Use Twitch Q Ambush to get to the flank or backline, then reveal yourself after Xayah R Featherstorm and the enemy team’s engage abilities have been used. Use Twitch R Spray and Pray to basic attack through a line of overlapping enemies, build Deadly Venom stacks on several targets, then use Twitch E Contaminate. If an enemy champion affected by Deadly Venom dies and resets Twitch Q Ambush’s cooldown, reposition.
Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots you if you’re hit by three or more returning feathers. Move sideways immediately if three or more feathers lie along the line between you and Xayah. Check whether Xayah R Featherstorm has been used, since she can dodge your attacks even if you approach first with Twitch Q Ambush while it’s available.

Yasuo.build: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath deal his main physical damage, so build armor first. Keep in mind that armor cannot block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: Remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first, then look for an opening after Yasuo W Wind Wall disappears. Use Twitch Q Ambush to get to his side, throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of Yasuo’s path, and build Deadly Venom stacks with basic attacks. Finish with Twitch E Contaminate before Yasuo gets out of range.
Yasuo.escape: Look for an opening right after Yasuo sends out his tornado, while he briefly has no way to knock you up. However, Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is a short-cooldown dash, so don’t chase in just because he used it once. Target him with your allies’ crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath is available again.
Yasuo.fight: Remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light poke before taking a full trade. Right after Yasuo sends out his tornado and his Q Steel Tempest stacks reset, use Twitch Q Ambush to get a flank angle and attack. Build Deadly Venom stacks with basic attacks and Twitch W Venom Cask, then use Twitch E Contaminate last.
Yasuo.laning: Twitch is weak early and has a hard time getting away once Yasuo gets on him, so avoid forced fights. Keep the wave thin and on your side of the lane to limit the minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can dash through. When it’s safe, use Twitch Q Ambush to circle through bushes or along the river, take a flank, and look for a kill opportunity.
Yasuo.phase: In the mid game, Twitch E Contaminate gains levels and creates kill opportunities using Deadly Venom stacks. The mid to late game is a strong period for Twitch, but start attacking after Yasuo uses his engage ability on your frontline.
Yasuo.teamfight: Don’t stand in front; use Twitch Q Ambush to get to the flank or backline. After Yasuo uses his engage ability on your frontline, activate Twitch R Spray and Pray and start basic attacking from an angle where enemies are lined up. Finish enemies marked with Deadly Venom using Twitch E Contaminate, then reposition if Twitch Q Ambush’s cooldown resets.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions as stepping stones to close the gap, so don’t let him close the distance when you’re in front of a wave with many minions. After Yasuo lands Q Steel Tempest twice, watch for the tornado knock-up and move sideways out of the line. When Yasuo W Wind Wall appears, go around it or save Twitch’s key attacks until it disappears.

Zeri.build: Build armor first to reduce the physical damage from Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Armor won’t stop the magic damage from Zeri P Living Battery and Zeri E Spark Surge, so keep an eye on health too. Zeri P Living Battery scales with maximum health and executes low-health targets, so be careful about choices that only increase your health by a lot.
Zeri.combo: Once you see that Zeri E Spark Surge is down, use Twitch Q Ambush to approach her from the side or behind. Throw Twitch W Venom Cask in her path and build more Deadly Venom stacks with basic attacks, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate. When using Twitch R Spray and Pray, activate it while camouflaged and start with a basic attack along a line where your attacks can pierce enemies.
Zeri.escape: The moment after Zeri E Spark Surge is used is your window to approach with Twitch Q Ambush. If Zeri is near a wall, she can use Zeri E Spark Surge to escape a long distance, so engage in open terrain. If Zeri R Lightning Crash is already active, don’t engage by chasing her.
Zeri.fight: Just after baiting out Zeri E Spark Surge, use Twitch Q Ambush to approach from the side and close the gap. In open terrain where Zeri has difficulty crossing walls, build Deadly Venom with Twitch W Venom Cask and basic attacks, then save Twitch E Contaminate to finish her. If Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, don’t force the chase.
Zeri.laning: Zeri has short basic attack range and limited kill pressure in lane, so use Twitch Q Ambush to circle through brush or along the river and look for a chance to kill her. After Zeri E Spark Surge is down, block her path with Twitch W Venom Cask and build Deadly Venom stacks.
Zeri.phase: As Twitch E Contaminate gains levels, it becomes easier to look for a kill after building Deadly Venom stacks. Twitch’s damage gets strong in the mid to late game, but once Zeri has her core items, her mobility makes her difficult to catch, so look for an opening when Zeri E Spark Surge is down.
Zeri.teamfight: Don’t stand in front of the enemy. Use Twitch Q Ambush to take a flanking position, then activate Twitch R Spray and Pray and basic attack along a line where enemies overlap. If Zeri R Lightning Crash is active and her movement speed is increased, don’t chase her on foot; look for an opening when Zeri E Spark Surge is down. Use Twitch E Contaminate to finish enemies affected by Deadly Venom. If an enemy champion affected by Deadly Venom dies and resets Twitch Q Ambush’s cooldown, reposition.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads out when it hits terrain, so avoid standing with your back to a wall or facing her head-on in a narrow passage. Zeri E Spark Surge travels farther when crossing a wall, so don’t corner her against one. After Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, her movement speed increases, so don’t chase her on foot.

Ziggs.build: First, get enough movement speed to help you walk out of the marked blast area. If you build resistance, get magic resistance to mitigate the magic damage from Ziggs P Short Fuse, Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb, and Ziggs W Satchel Charge.
Ziggs.combo: Use Twitch Q Ambush to take a position beside or behind Ziggs, then approach from a direction without Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield. Throw Twitch W Venom Cask ahead of Ziggs’s path and build more Deadly Venom stacks with basic attacks. Use Twitch E Contaminate to finish after you’ve built up the stacks.
Ziggs.escape: Engage immediately after Ziggs W Satchel Charge, his mobility tool, has been fully spent. If Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield remains along your approach, take another route or wait for it to disappear.
Ziggs.fight: Immediately after Ziggs W Satchel Charge has been fully spent, use Twitch Q Ambush to get to his side or behind him. Avoid paths covered by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, build Deadly Venom with Twitch W Venom Cask and basic attacks, then finish with Twitch E Contaminate.
Ziggs.laning: Your chance to engage comes just after Ziggs uses a full set of abilities or uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge to poke or clear the wave. Let your allies know when you leave lane to circle around with Twitch Q Ambush.
Ziggs.phase: As Twitch E Contaminate gains levels, it becomes easier to find kills using Deadly Venom stacks. In the mid to late game, take advantage of Twitch’s attack speed and critical strike strengths by positioning well and fighting.
Ziggs.teamfight: Don’t stand in front of the enemy. Use Twitch Q Ambush to take a flanking position, then start basic attacks with Twitch R Spray and Pray along a line where enemies overlap. Avoid paths blocked by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, and don’t group together where Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb can hit several of you at once. If an enemy affected by Deadly Venom dies and resets Twitch Q Ambush’s cooldown, reposition.
Ziggs.watch: If you’re slowed by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, you’re more likely to get hit by his other abilities, so take a path without mines or wait for them to disappear. When the area of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb appears, move away from the center of the blast even if you can’t dodge it completely. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is available, account for the possibility that he can knock you back or escape over a wall.
